performance.methodology: Production build, ?perf=1 (quality HIGH, devicePixelRatio fixed 1.5, no adaptive degradation), viewport 1440x900, 3 s warm-up, then 600 consecutive requestAnimationFrame intervals (~10 s). Flight measured while flying. Draw calls/triangles from WebGLRenderer.info (include shadow passes). Source: artifacts/perf/perf-results.json
performance.notes: Values are capped by the 60 Hz display (vsync). An uncapped run is in perf-results.json but is only an upper bound of loop throughput (frames may not be presented; timer resolution ~0.1 ms). Single high-end desktop GPU; no mobile/integrated GPU measured.

runtimeErrors.source: measure-perf.mjs (requestfailed + HTTP >= 400 + pageerror listeners on hangar and flight), capture-screenshots.mjs (pageerror on 5 views), and every Playwright page test asserting zero page/console errors (deliberate 4xx API calls excluded)

knownIncompleteRequirements: No automated in-browser test flies the full five-gate course (full completion is proven in unit tests with an input-driven autopilot; the browser test covers gate 1 + collision penalty)
Playwright suite not executed on Linux/CI in this run
Performance measured only on one desktop GPU at the 60 Hz vsync cap
Server cannot verify that a client-reported result was actually flown (documented limitation)

usage.note: Billing/token data not exposed by the environment. Plan usage reported by the app at report time: ~43% of the 5-hour window, ~37% weekly (Pro plan); session context ~452k tokens. Not a billed-token or cost figure.
